title: Onion Architecture
description: Structure systems with domain logic at the core and dependencies pointing inward.

data.text:
**Onion Architecture**

Places the domain model at the center, surrounded by concentric layers of services, interfaces, and infrastructure.

items: Domain model is the innermost layer
All dependencies point toward the center
Outer layers implement interfaces defined by inner layers

data.title: Onion Layers in C#
Key Takeaways
points: Domain logic is isolated and testable
Easy to swap databases or UIs
data.takeaway: Onion Architecture protects your core business logic from framework churn.
